FERRARIS, LLAMAS & ROUGHRIDERS TIE FOR WEEK 1 LEAD AS PFPI KICKS OFF 23RD SEASON OF MODERN ERA

Christie’s Ferraris, Dick’s Roughriders and Tati’s Llamas share Week 1 honors with 12-4 records as PFPI’s 31st season and 23rd of the modern era is underway! Three other teams including reigning champion Chris Critters are 2 games back.

The Llamas scored the week’s lone Unique Hit, cashing a Coonskin for 49ers over Rams.

So we’re off and running – one week down and 17 to go – in the marathon climb to the Dad’s Dynamics Championship Trophy.
